originality.rationale: The inspected all-indexing-complex homology decomposition of Zhang gives the essential general computational framework, not the explicit graph-theoretic onset degree and rank. Exact constrained-minimum inversion analysis converts the general formula into a first-even-degree/chordality classification and new weighted cycle multiplicity. Parks proves chordal clique acyclicity, not partial-flag parity detection. The full relevant primary texts and semantic database results were compared, including coverage by the stronger Zhang theorem; any claim that this work is independent of Zhang would be false. Residual risk of an unindexed equivalent corollary remains.
residual_risks: The new theorem is a logically derived refinement of a much broader published homology formula, so some mathematical audiences may categorize it as an implicit corollary rather than an independent theorem.
Equivalent earlier weighted minimum-descent-cycle calculations could exist under different terminology or outside the searchable index.
Higher even homology may have torsion for nonchordal graphs and is not determined by the onset formula.
